title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E18 — Road Games
As payment for a debt, the mob demands a reformed gambler (Jason Evers) sign over a foster home he and his daughter run.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E19 — Moving Targets
Rebels pursue an Arabian princess (Sue Kiel) the team is escorting to her wedding; guests John Saxon, Frank Annese.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E20 — Knights of the Road
The team confronts a greedy towing-service operator (Don Stroud) pressuring a one-truck competitor to fold.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E21 — Waste 'Em!
The team battles a garbage-disposal company sabotaging its competitor and dumping toxic waste into city sewers.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E7 — Behind the Wheel
The owner (Esther Rolle) of an endangered taxicab company hires Banner to fend off drug smugglers.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E3 — Brain Child
Banner tries to reunite a gifted teen with her mother, who is accused of kidnapping; guest June Allyson.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E11 — Captive Night
Banner throws in with thieves to thwart a department-store robbery; guests Anne Lockhart, Mark Lenard.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E12 — Broken Image
Mistaken for a hoodlum, Banner is the target of a gang and police.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S3 E17 — Lottery
Banner must send a friend to collect lottery winnings, with dangerous results.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E14 — Hearts of Stone
In Texas, Michael and KITT target gunrunners handling assault rifles.

title: Knight Rider
description:
S1 E15 — Give Me Liberty ... Or Give Me Death
Michael enters a race for vehicles propelled by alternative fuels to flush out a saboteur who is putting the drivers' lives in jeopardy.
